entries.symptom: The first animation runs; every later one freezes, then jumps to the end
entries.cause: Reanimated resets timeSinceFirstFrame to 0 whenever a frame callback is re-activated (verified in react-native-reanimated 4.5 FrameCallbackRegistryUI)
entries.fix: Record a start time from frame.timestamp on the first frame of each run and use timestamp - start; never timeSinceFirstFrame for an animation that restarts

entries.symptom: A canvas freezes after an exception inside a frame callback
entries.cause: An uncaught error on the UI thread stops the callback silently
entries.fix: Wrap each frame body in one runner that catches, stops the callback and reports through scheduleOnRN, so the app pauses and records the error

entries.symptom: The phone stays warm while nothing moves
entries.cause: A frame callback (or a Picture that reads the clock) keeps running every frame
entries.fix: Stop the frame callback when nothing animates; pause on background (useIsAppActive), focus loss and full-screen ads

entries.symptom: runOnJS logs a deprecation warning, or code written from memory uses runOnJS
entries.cause: react-native-worklets 0.10 deprecates runOnJS (@deprecated Use scheduleOnRN)
entries.fix: Use scheduleOnRN(fn, ...args) from react-native-worklets

entries.symptom: Shared value updates misbehave under the React Compiler, or the compiler lint flags .value
entries.cause: .value property access is not compiler-safe
entries.fix: Use .get() and .set()

entries.symptom: A crash on the UI thread when a gesture or frame callback calls a helper: "is not a worklet" or "Tried to synchronously call"
entries.cause: A function without the 'worklet' directive cannot run on the UI thread (a runtime error, not a build error)
entries.fix: Add 'worklet' (or a file-level directive for pure geometry modules) and test that UI-thread modules import only worklet modules

entries.symptom: A worklet keeps using an old value after JS changed it
entries.cause: Values captured by a worklet are copied when it is first scheduled
entries.fix: Pass anything that changes through a shared value; no promises, await, setTimeout or third-party code inside worklets

entries.symptom: withSpring feels heavy and slow after the Reanimated 4 upgrade
entries.cause: Reanimated 4's default spring is the 'gentle' config (mass 4, stiffness 900, damping 120), not Reanimated 3's mass 1
entries.fix: Pass the spring config from the motion tokens explicitly on every withSpring

entries.symptom: Changing Reduce Motion while the app runs has no effect on some animations
entries.cause: Reanimated's useReducedMotion is read once at module load
entries.fix: Read reduce motion through the app's a11y store (useReduceMotion) and a root ReducedMotionConfig

entries.symptom: A decorative loop keeps moving with Reduce Motion on, and screenshots of that screen never settle
entries.cause: A withRepeat loop never reads the reduce-motion setting
entries.fix: Make the loop rest when useReduceMotion() is true (or pass ReduceMotion.System); screenshot tooling then gets a still screen too

entries.symptom: Skia logs a deprecation warning for moveTo, addCircle or transform on an SkPath
entries.cause: Skia 2.6 moved to immutable paths built with Skia.PathBuilder; the old mutators still work but warn and will be removed
entries.fix: Build paths with Skia.PathBuilder.Make()...build() once, and place them with canvas save/translate/scale/restore

entries.symptom: Canvas onLayout does not fire on the New Architecture
entries.cause: Canvas onLayout is deprecated on Fabric
entries.fix: Use onSize or useCanvasSize()

entries.symptom: Arabic-script words drawn on a canvas render as broken, unjoined letters
entries.cause: canvas.drawText does no text shaping
entries.fix: Use a Skia Paragraph (ParagraphBuilder with TextDirection.RTL) for shaped text; drawText only for digits and Latin

entries.symptom: Frame drops when a canvas shows text
entries.cause: Building a Paragraph every frame is costly
entries.fix: Build on text or locale change and cache it; draw a retained Paragraph node

entries.symptom: Path icons render as filled blobs (rings and cut-outs filled in)
entries.cause: A path union comes back with the even-odd fill rule
entries.fix: Apply AsWinding after the union (or set the fill type explicitly)

entries.symptom: Animations run at 60 Hz on a 120 Hz iPhone
entries.cause: Info.plist lacks CADisableMinimumFrameDurationOnPhone = true (an override removed what the SDK 57 prebuild template sets)
entries.fix: Keep the template value; the canvas checker reports an override

entries.symptom: The iOS simulator never exceeds 60 fps; a 120 Hz loop measures about 116 ticks/s
entries.cause: The simulator is capped at 60 fps and its display-link timing differs
entries.fix: Count ticks, never wall time; check 120 Hz on a real high-refresh device

entries.symptom: A 90 Hz Android phone shows false hitches in frame measurements
entries.cause: The measurement assumed 120 Hz frame budgets on a 90 Hz display
entries.fix: Read the display's refresh rate and judge frames against its own budget (8.3, 11.1 or 16.7 ms)

entries.symptom: Gesture callbacks never fire after a Gesture Handler 3 upgrade, or gestures cannot be composed
entries.cause: Gesture Handler 3 renames onStart to onActivate and onEnd to onDeactivate, merges onChange into onUpdate, and hook-based gestures cannot relate to builder gestures
entries.fix: Keep gestures behind one hook per surface and move all of its gestures to the new API in one commit

entries.symptom: A list does not scroll when a drag starts on a slider, and the value jumps
entries.cause: The slider's pan gesture had minDistance(0)
entries.fix: Race pan and tap: the pan activates after a few points sideways and fails after a few points vertically; check on a device

entries.symptom: Swipes feel wrong or taps wait
entries.cause: Gesture thresholds and composition order were never validated on a device
entries.fix: Tune on a device; test Exclusive(pan, longPress, tap) so taps do not wait

entries.symptom: Gestures behave differently in right-to-left on Android
entries.cause: Gesture coordinates are physical; only iOS was probed
entries.fix: Run the gesture tests and a device check in RTL on Android before shipping RTL
